scope: Read-only source review and configuration/reference-receipt metadata checks. No CLI, benchmark, or fault-injection execution.

checks.balanced_pair_order: BC on rounds 1/3/5, CB on rounds 2/4/6; rotating case order
checks.reference_generation: Independent Python integer interval union and ipaddress summarization; coverage digest, ranges, minimal CIDR count and per-family address cardinality checked against prior oracle
checks.complete_output_check: Byte count and SHA-256 plus shallow=False full file comparison after timing
checks.native_resources: Darwin native time CPU and RSS bytes; Linux exact-child wait4 CPU and KiB RSS converted to bytes
checks.timeout: 180-second timer; only owned process group killed; exit-race ProcessLookupError tolerated and child reaped or already-reaped state retained
checks.failure_preservation: Exclusive sample/summary receipts and files; no retry or observation filtering in runner
checks.deduplication: After timer and exact-reference validation; verified output linked into content store; temporary hardlink atomically replaces sample path so link/replace failure preserves original
checks.disk_guard: Before each sample free space must cover 3 GiB plus next expected stdout; after post-sample operations at least 3 GiB; hardlink dedup adds no second output-sized allocation
checks.input_freeze: Cases, both binaries, runner, all selected inputs and references hashed before and after complete measurement
checks.os_resource_unit_guard: Actual platform.system() must match selected Darwin/Linux resource semantics
checks.zero_cpu_summary: Missing percentage changes are omitted; an entirely empty set produces JSON null instead of median-of-empty failure

integration_conditions: Pass the experiment directory to --fixtures-root because case paths begin fixtures/.
Platform owners separately bind successful tests, dependency/source gates, compiler/runtime identities and linked-runtime hashes before/after timing; this runner alone does not enforce those gates.
macOS elapsed includes its native time wrapper; compare B/C within platform and do not normalize absolute cross-platform times.
Post-sample comparison/hash/hardlink work can influence cache state between samples and must be disclosed.
